newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms ratings on Finning's debt.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms ratings on Finning's debt.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it had confirmed an A (low) rating with a stable trend on senior debentures issued by Finning International Inc.
DBRS also said it confirmed a R-1 (low) rating with a stable trend for Finning's commercial paper.
"The balance sheet has stabilized, and the profitability ratios remained favourable in 1996," DBRS said.
"Finning, being a working capital-oriented company, has the financial flexibility to support the present debt levels," DBRS added.
